name: When should I consider custom-fit cabinets instead of standard options?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider custom-fit cabinets instead of standard options?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider custom-fit cabinets when you have unique space requirements, desire a specific aesthetic that isn't available with standard options, or want to maximize every inch of usable storage. This is particularly beneficial for kitchens with unusual layouts, bathrooms requiring specialized storage, or built-in solutions for living areas where standard sizes won't fit perfectly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider custom cabinets for unique spaces, specific aesthetics, or when maximizing storage in non-standard layouts is a priority.
